data.title: Improve Website Speed and Reliability
data.outcome: Use loading evidence to find the main bottlenecks and improve resources, requests, and failure recovery.

stages.title: First identify what the page is waiting on
stages.action: Observe the timing of the first screen, resources, and API requests.
stages.evidence: You can tell whether the main wait comes from page resources or data requests.

lessons.title: Skeleton
lessons.tagline: Reserve the layout while content is loading

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

lessons.title: HTTP
lessons.tagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web

stages.title: Reduce unnecessary image and video load
stages.action: Compress media and choose an appropriate loading strategy.
stages.evidence: Key visuals appear faster while retaining acceptable clarity.

lessons.title: Image
lessons.tagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

lessons.title: Video
lessons.tagline: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page

lessons.title: CDN
lessons.tagline: Serve static files from locations closer to visitors

stages.title: Reduce repeated requests and oversized data transfers
stages.action: Combine or limit unnecessary requests and reduce returned data.
stages.evidence: Primary actions do not trigger duplicate or unlimited requests.

lessons.title: API
lessons.tagline: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information

lessons.title: JSON
lessons.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

lessons.title: Rate Limit
lessons.tagline: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time

stages.title: Make production failures discoverable and recoverable
stages.action: Add logs, error messages, and a way to retry.
stages.evidence: A failure can be recorded, explained, and tried again.

lessons.title: Server Logs
lessons.tagline: Record what the server did so problems can be traced

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

lessons.title: Result
lessons.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step
